content: Nyubun sheep nubijin.
Juma bama wubul kadarin, Jesusamu kuku nyajinka. Kanbalda tax money mujan Governmentamu, kanbal bama buyun.
Jana Pharisee-warra, teacher-teacher lawmunku, jana kuli-kadarin. Jana yalaman, “Nyulu bama buyun kunjal, jananji mayi nukal-nukal.”
Yinyaynka Jesusangka jananda yinya story balkan.

Nyulu yalaman, “Nguba bama nyubun sheepmunji wubuljiku, 100-balanji. Yamba nyubun sheep nubijin. Nyulu bama wanjarrmalda? Nyulu kanbal bawal, jikanba nukal-nukajinya. Nyulu dungayda, nubinka yinya sheep nyubun nubijinya, juma warrmba-bungal.
Nyulu warrmba-bungal, nyulu wawurr-wawurrmal. Nyulu bindanga-bungal,
bayanbaku jarra-kulbalda. Yinyamun nyulu jawun-karra kunjal, jananda balkal, ‘Ngayku sheep nubijin, yamba ngayu warrmba-bungan baja. Ngana wubulduku mayi nukankada, wawurr-wawurrmanijida.’

Yala yinya story sheepmunku, kaki nyubun bama buyun nyuluku Godundu jurrkiji, jana angel-angel heavenba wawurr-wawurrmal. Jana nyungunku wawurr-wawurrmalarrku. Jana angel-angel bamanka 99-balanka ngulkurrku wawurr-wawurrmanijikuda, yamba nyungunku buyunyunku jana wawurr-wawurrmalarrkukuda, nyulu buyunmun Godundu jurrkijinya.”
Nyubun kulji money nubijin.

Jesusangka yindu story balkan baja. “Jalbu nyubun nguba moneyji silverji 10-balaji, yamba nyubun nubijin. Nyulu jalbu wanjarrmalda? Nyulu light wayjul, bubu kidal, yiringkurrku nubil-nubil, juma nyulu warrmba-bungal.
Nyulu warrmba-bungal, nyulu jawun-karra wubulku kunjal, balkalda, ‘Ngayu wawurr-wawurrmalda, ngayku money nyubunku warrmba-bunganya. Ngana wubulku wawurr-wawurrmalda.’
Yala yinya story moneyka, Godumu angel-angel wawurr-wawurrmal bama buyun Godundu jurrkijinya.”
Kangkal yala nubijin.
Jesusangka yalaman baja, “Dingkar nyubun kangkalji jambulji. Bula yaba-yabaju.
Yabajungku nganjananda yalaman, ‘Nganjan, yundu ngalinyanga bubu, and yamba-yamba dayada, ngayku share ngaykundu dayada.’ Yinyaynka nyulu nganjanangka wubulku dajin, bulanda kangkalba dajin.

Warngku kulurman, nyulu yabajungku nyungu bubu sellim-bungan, money manin, bulanin nganjan, and yaba bawan. Nyulu bubungu kala-kalbaymba dungan. Yinyaymba nyulu moneybu buyun way wukurrin, kamu-kamu nukan, money buyun-daman, wasteim-bungan.
Juma nyulu money-kariman. Wawu yinyamun kaba kari kadan baja yinyaymba bubungu. Yinyaynka mayi bubanman. Nyulu yabaju money kari, dakwuymankuda. Nyulu workmunbu nubil-nubijinda.
Dingkar nyubun yinyaymba bikibiki wubul. Nyulu dingkarangka yabajundu work dajin, bikibiki miyil-kujinka.
Yabajungku bikibiki nyajin, mayi nukal-nukanya. Nyulu dakwuyku bundandan, mayi bikibikimu nukanka, yamba bamangka nyungundu mayi kari dajin.
Juma nyungundu dukulbu kadan, ‘Ngaykuwunbu nganjanandamunbu workingmanamu mayi jirray, yamba ngayu yaluy dakwuyku bunday, mayi kari bajaku.
Ngayu nganjanandaku dungay, nyungundu balkal, “Nganjan, ngayu yunun buyun-daman. Ngayu yalarrku God buyun-daman.
Ngayu murru-kaday ngaykuwunku buyun-buyunku. Yundu nganya karida kangkal bamba, nganya workingman bamba.” ’

Nyulu yalaku milkabu wukurrin, yinyamun nyulu wandin, nganjanandaku dunganka baja. “Nyulu bayanbaku kankadan, nganjanangka nyungun nyajin kala-kalbaymun kankadanya. Nyulu jiba-badin, manun-manunman kangkalanka. Nyulu nyungundu warrin, baru karrban, wawurr-wawurrmanda.
Yabajungku yalaman, ‘Nganjan, ngayu yunun buyun-daman, yalarrku ngayu God buyun-daman. Nganya karida kangkal bamba.’
Yamba nganjanangka workingman kunjan, yalaman, ‘Jinbal, kambi ngulkurrku wundi, nyungundu dida. Ring wundi, maranga dida. Dambal nyunguwunbu jinanga dida.
Yinyamun yurra bulki wandul kuni, mayi jirray wayjunku. Ngana mayi jirray nukanka, wurinka.
Yanyu kangkal yala wulan, yamba nyulu yala juranman baja. Nyulu yala nubijin, yamba nyulu warrmbaman baja.’ Yinyamun jana mayi yalbay nukan.
“Yala-yala nyulu yaba ngalkalba paddockmunbu workmalman. Nyulu bayanbaku kankadan, nyulu jananin nyajin wulngku banbadinya, wurinya.
Yinyaynka nyulu nyubun workingman kunjan, nyungundu babajin, ‘Jana bama wanjarrmalmal?’
Nyulu workingmanangka yalaman, ‘Yunu yabaju bayanbaku kadan baja. Yunuwundu nganjanangka bulki wandul kunin, yabaju ngulkurrku bayanbaku kadanya.’
“Nyulu yaba kuli-kadan, kari bayanba walan. Yinyaynka nganjan ngalkalba kadan, yaba walay-maninka. Yamba yaba kari walan.

Yabangka nganjananda yalaman, ‘Yundu nyaka. Ngayu ngadi bajaku yunundu workmanijin, yala slave. Ngayu yunu kuku mumbarabuku wukurrin. Yundu ngaykundu wanyu dajin workmunku? Yamba-karibi! Yundu minya kari dajin, ngayu jawun-karranji nukanka. Minya karrkay yala nanny goat yundu kari dajin.

Yamba yunu kangkal, ngayku yabaju, nyulu maral-maral buyun wunanan, yunu money wasteim-bungan, buyun-daman. Yinya kangkal bayanbaku kadan baja, yundu minya bulki wandul kunin, mayi jirray wayjun, nyungun wawurr-wawurr-bunganka.’
Nganjanangka yabanda yalaman, ‘Yundu ngayku kangkalkuda, yundu wuljaljiku ngaykunji. Yanyu bubu, yamba-yamba, money, wubulku yunuda.
Yamba yunu yabaju, nyulu yala nyulu juranman baja juljalmun. Nyulu nubijin, ngana nyungun warrmba-bungan baja. Yinyaynka ngana mayi yalbay wayjunku nyungunku.’”
